description: Source code for audit logging and audit record management in the Mattermost server, including functions for retrieving audits, logging audit records, configuring audit settings, and managing audit log certificates.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for audit management and configuration.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Server struct handling audit configuration and event callbacks.

methods.name: GetAudits
methods.description: Retrieves a list of audits for a user with a specified limit.

methods.name: GetAuditsPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of audits for a user.

methods.name: LogAuditRec
methods.description: Logs an audit record with default CLI level.

methods.name: LogAuditRecWithLevel
methods.description: Logs an audit record with a specified log level.

methods.name: MakeAuditRecord
methods.description: Creates a new audit record with default values.

methods.name: configureAudit
methods.description: Configures audit settings, including advanced logging and environment overrides.

methods.name: onAuditTargetQueueFull
methods.description: Callback when the audit queue is full; drops the record.

methods.name: onAuditError
methods.description: Handles audit errors by logging them.

methods.name: AddAuditLogCertificate
methods.description: Adds an audit log certificate from an uploaded file.
